title: Monthly spending
incompleteBankTotals: Some bank accounts have an unavailable balance or currency.
balanceHelp: Balances retain their reported signs and currencies. Credit card balances can represent liabilities.
accountLimit: Showing the first 200 accounts for this connection.
historyError: Balance history could not be loaded.
noHistory: No balance observations are available for this account.
investmentHelp: Each row shows the last reported position. Check its reference date before treating a value as current.
investmentLimit: Showing the first 200 positions for this connection.
saveError: The category could not be saved.
reviewError: The review decision could not be saved.
noReviews: No debits to review this month.
reviewHelp: Debits without enough evidence wait here, from every month. Once you include or exclude one, it leaves this list; reviewed debits stay below, where they can be reset.
reviewLimit: Showing up to 100 debits, with unreviewed debits first.
selectForSpending: Select a connection to view its spending.
noExpenses: No expenses are available. Load the synthetic demo or replay a connection.
matchingExpenses: Choose a category and where it applies: this merchant, every card purchase with the same MCC, or every expense in the same bank category.
suggestionsReady: Review the suggestions below before applying them.
noSuggestions: The model had no suggestion for these expenses.
suggestionsUnavailable: Local suggestions are unavailable. Check that the Ollama model is installed.
reportedInvestmentTotals: Reported investment net balances by currency
incompleteInvestmentTotals: Some positions have no reported net balance or currency.
monthlyComparisonHelp: Account debits and card purchases over the last 12 months, excluding transfers between accounts and card bill payments. Select a month to open it.
investmentComparisonHelp: Contributions minus withdrawals over the last 12 months, including savings boxes and fixed income. Bars below the line mean more was withdrawn than invested. Income is shown separately.
categoriesHelp: Rename, add, move or archive categories and subcategories. Totals and rules follow the change immediately. Archiving hides a category and its subcategories, and its expenses return to automatic classification.
archiveCategoryConfirm: Archive {name}? Its expenses return to automatic classification.
categorySaveError: The category change could not be saved.
scopeProvider: Every expense in the bank category
manualExpensesHelp: Add expenses the bank does not report, such as rent paid from a savings box. A recurring entry repeats every month from its start until its end month (or until now). With a CNPJ, months that already have a reported payment to that CNPJ skip the entry, so a bill never counts twice.
manualError: The entry could not be saved or loaded.
savingsBoxOutflow: Left a savings box without a reported transaction
investedEvolutionHelp: Invested money at the end of each month, by investment class, gross of income tax. Days without a stored balance start from the nearest one, through the purchases and sales reported in between and the daily yield of CDI, Selic and fixed-rate positions (savings boxes included) or the daily price of Tesouro Direto bonds, funds, stocks and ETFs. Positions without a rate or a public price show money put in on those days, not market value.
categoryNotEditable: Count this transaction as an expense or refund first to set its category.
investedGapsTitle: Money left without a reported withdrawal.
investedGapsHelp: These positions received more than they hold and returned: the rest left without a reported withdrawal, such as bills paid straight from a savings box. Until each payment is registered (as a manual entry paid from the box), earlier months show them at zero.
receiptsHelp: Transfers you received this month. Count one as a refund when it pays back part of an expense, such as a friend's share of a dinner: it then reduces the subcategory you choose.
boxSuggestions: Likely paid from a savings box
boxSuggestionsHelp: The bank does not report bills paid straight from a savings box: the evidence is the box balance falling without a reported withdrawal. Observed suggestions are drops seen between two syncs, with their exact amount, named by a monthly bill that fits. Before the first stored balance only the total that left is known: estimated suggestions place monthly bills that are missing from a month only while the box keeps enough money for every later withdrawal. Accept one to record it as a manual entry paid from that box (adjust the amount first if needed), or ignore it.
boxYield: Yield is discounted at about {rate}% a day (120% CDI), estimated from a box whose balance only grew.
boxGap: {box}: {gap} left without a reported withdrawal ({observed} observed since {since}); suggestions below cover {suggested}.
observedRange: Paid between {low} and {high} in other months
investmentClassesHelp: Each position starts in an automatic class from its type and indexer. Choose another class for a position, or create, rename and delete classes; a position in a deleted class returns to its automatic class.
deleteInvestmentClassConfirm: Delete the class {name}? Its positions return to their automatic class.
investmentReturnsHelp: Time-weighted returns up to {date}, before income tax. Each position earns its rate (CDI, Selic or fixed) or follows its public market price, so contributions, withdrawals and payments made from savings boxes are not counted as gains or losses, and Tesouro coupons count as earned. A position held for less than the period shows its return since it was bought.
returnsUncovered: Not included: these positions have neither a rate nor a public price.
